resources.string: Claude and Codex side by side: the window that is actually limiting you, when it resets, and every other window at a glance.
One thin row per provider — percent used and time until reset. Fits a single row of the home screen.
Two dial gauges showing how much of your tightest limit is spent, and how long until it resets.
A 24-hour chart of how fast you have been burning through your providers.
Each AI drawn as a battery — how much of the limit is left before it runs dry.
The time until each limit resets, with how far through the window you are.
A one-line readout of every provider — the smallest possible footprint.
